overview: OpenAI expands hands‑on AI education for caregivers, while Google rolls out its strongest Gemini model with agent swarms.
DeepMind showcases advances in software verification and robot dexterity, highlighting growing capabilities beyond language models.
New York’s RAISE Act begins enforcement, imposing registration, safety reporting, and transparency requirements on frontier AI firms.

top.title: Helping caregivers use AI in everyday life
top.summary: OpenAI Academy launches free, in‑person ChatGPT workshops for caregivers in five U.S. cities, teaching practical AI use for daily tasks and support.

top.title: Introducing Businesses in ChatGPT
top.summary: OpenAI adds a Business profile feature in ChatGPT, letting companies manage information, gain visibility insights, and convert interest into actions directly within the chat interface.

top.title: Google releases Gemini 4 Carbon with agent ‘swarm’ feature
top.summary: Google releases Gemini 4 Carbon, its most powerful model yet, with a “swarm” agent feature for coordinated multi‑agent tasks, priced competitively for developers and enterprises.

top.title: Introducing AlphaProof Code: a breakthrough in verifying complex software at depth
top.summary: DeepMind’s AlphaProof Code agents generated three million lines of Lean proofs to verify Signal’s core encryption, demonstrating large‑scale formal verification capabilities.

top.title: Gemini Robotics 2.5 accelerates real-world general dexterity
top.summary: DeepMind introduces Gemini Robotics 2.5, a vision‑language‑action model that improves robot dexterity, reliability, and safety for real‑world general‑purpose tasks.

top.title: OpenAI, Anthropic face new oversight as New York’s AI safety law takes effect
top.summary: New York’s RAISE Act takes effect, requiring frontier AI developers to register, publish safety frameworks, report incidents within 72 hours, and face penalties for non‑compliance.
